_comment: REHEARSAL. Filled from 2026 REBUILT GameManual (TU22) Tables 6-2/6-4/6-5, pp.44-48. [VERIFIED]
_schema_gap_1: teleop_s is the FULL 140s TELEOP incl. the 30s ENDGAME. cycle-model.py subtracts the chosen fixed_action time_s as endgame reserve, so do not double-count.
_schema_gap_2: REBUILT gates FUEL on HUB ACTIVE/INACTIVE (Table 6-3). Each ALLIANCE HUB is active only 10s TRANSITION + 2 of 4 x25s SHIFTS + 30s ENDGAME = 90s of 140s. The schema cannot express a duty cycle, so raw model output overstates FUEL by ~1.56x. Corrected by hand in REVIEW.md section 2.
name: REBUILT (2026) -- REHEARSAL stand-in for BIOCORE

cycle_actions.name: FUEL scored in an active HUB
cycle_actions._note: 1 pt AUTO and TELEOP [VERIFIED Table 6-4 p.47]. 0 in an inactive HUB. per_cycle=8 is an [INFERENCE] hopper capacity for a small-team robot; CHUTE retains ~25 FUEL (p.717).

_fixed_note: L1 AUTO=15 / TELEOP=10; L2=20 TELEOP only; L3=30 TELEOP only [VERIFIED Table 6-4]. A ROBOT may earn L1 only in AUTO and only a SINGLE LEVEL during TELEOP; an AUTO scorer may also score in TELEOP (p.46). time_s values are [INFERENCE] -- the manual states no time cost for any action.

rp.name: ENERGIZED
rp.note: Regional/District 100 -> DCMP 240 -> Champs 360 [VERIFIED Table 6-5 p.48]. 3.6x escalation: an RP-optimised design correct at Week 1 is wrong at DCMP.

rp.name: SUPERCHARGED
rp.note: 360 / 360 / 500. Alliance-wide; unreachable solo at any tier.

rp.name: TRAVERSAL
rp.metric: TOWER points scored during the MATCH
rp.note: 50 at ALL THREE tiers -- the only non-escalating BONUS RP. This is the cheapest RP in the game and the small-team lever.
